Summary.title: 📋 Professional Summary
Summary.paragraph1: I am a full stack developer focused on organization, continuous learning, and building sustainable solutions. Throughout my career, I have worked both in multi-system ecosystems and in highly autonomous environments, taking independent ownership of technical decisions.
Summary.paragraph2: I have a strong aptitude for understanding new business contexts, designing clean architectures, and delivering systems that are easy to use, maintain, and scale. My foundation combines hands-on experience with a continuous pursuit of deep technical knowledge.

system-hub-rpg.title: System Hub RPG - SaaS Platform
system-hub-rpg.subtitle: Creator, Software Architect & Full Stack Developer
system-hub-rpg.description: Complete Virtual Tabletop (VTT) SaaS platform and RPG campaign management, featuring a scalable, universal rule engine.
system-hub-rpg.context: I started this project as a personal challenge to apply and deepen my skills after a period away from the market. The goal was to build a complete solution from scratch, which evolved from helping a friend into a fully functional SaaS.
system-hub-rpg.challenge: The biggest challenge was architecting a system complex and flexible enough to support different RPG systems. This required deep data modeling, multiple refactorings, and building a 'Rule Engine' that unifies items, characters, inventories, and lore cohesively.
system-hub-rpg.action: Using Next.js, TypeScript, Prisma, and Supabase, I built the entire architecture. I created modules for campaign management, item and component registries, NPC sheets with dynamic inventories, an interactive map with customizable tokens, and a world lore section. The system was designed to be modular and ready for future AI integrations.
system-hub-rpg.result: System Hub RPG became my most comprehensive project, validating my ability to take a SaaS product from idea to execution. The architecture allows for the creation of dynamic universes and is currently evolving to include generative AI that will assist in creating items, sheets, and side-quests based on the lore of each campaign.
system-hub-rpg.shortPhrase: Conceived and developed a Virtual Tabletop (VTT) and RPG campaign management SaaS platform from scratch, focusing on a universal and scalable rule engine.

dre-compta.title: Financial Dashboard & P&L Statement
dre-compta.subtitle: Rapid understanding of business rules + scalable architecture
dre-compta.description: Financial dashboard system with P&L (Profit and Loss) generation for an accounting firm.
dre-compta.context: I joined the project with no prior experience in accounting and had to quickly understand the logic of P&L statements, financial indicators, and how this information needed to be organized within the system.
dre-compta.challenge: Besides learning a new domain in a short time, I was the sole developer at the company. This required not only implementing the solution but also making architectural decisions, choosing technologies, and ensuring scalability and future maintainability.
dre-compta.action: In less than 3 months, I managed to absorb the necessary business rules, structure the financial dashboard, and organize the solution so the system would be user-friendly for the client and easy to scale for future developers.
dre-compta.result: The project became a major turning point in my career because it showcased my ability to learn complex domains rapidly, translate them into a product, and build a clean foundation for the system's growth.
dre-compta.shortPhrase: Learned applied accounting for P&L statements in less than 3 months and transformed that understanding into a scalable, highly maintainable dashboard.

ia-sistema.title: AI Integrated Navigation & Automation
ia-sistema.subtitle: Self-taught learning + practical functionality
ia-sistema.description: AI integration capable of interacting with the system, changing screens, modifying filters, and generating automated reports.
ia-sistema.context: During the development of the Compta system, I identified an opportunity to explore AI practically, going beyond generic responses to seek useful integration with the application.
ia-sistema.challenge: I had never implemented this kind of solution before. The challenge was to study on my own, understand how to integrate AI into the system's workflow, and make it execute genuinely relevant actions.
ia-sistema.action: I developed an integration where the AI could interact with the software, navigating through screens, modifying filters, generating short reports, and sending results via email.
ia-sistema.result: This experience reinforced my ability to learn autonomously, quickly apply new technologies, and turn technical curiosity into real product value.
ia-sistema.shortPhrase: Implemented an AI capable of interacting with the system interface, changing filters, generating reports, and automating email dispatch.

ecossistema-buildings.title: Component-Sharing System Ecosystem
ecossistema-buildings.subtitle: Full stack foundation built over 7 years
ecossistema-buildings.description: Structuring and evolving an ecosystem of systems that shared components while preserving their individual requirements.
ecossistema-buildings.context: At Buildings, I worked for about 7 years in a small team environment where developers had to handle frontend, backend, databases, and integrations.
ecossistema-buildings.challenge: Maintaining consistency and component reusability across several different systems, each with its own specific customizations, without causing duplication or excessive rigidity.
ecossistema-buildings.action: I directly participated in the creation and evolution of various websites and systems, working with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, PHP, database modeling, SQL, and APIs. I helped build a framework capable of sustaining a broad ecosystem.
ecossistema-buildings.result: This experience consolidated my full-stack vision and my strong focus on consistency, reusability, and architectural scalability in products.
ecossistema-buildings.shortPhrase: Helped structure an ecosystem of systems with reusable components and per-product customization, working across frontend, backend, and databases.
